## Use WhisperShortcut from Claude
- **Connect an AI app from the Chat.** An empty Chat now shows a short tip: connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex over MCP, then ask them about a meeting while it records, or let them tune your dictation with fixes you approve. The button opens Settings → Claude & AI Apps. The tip disappears once an app is connected, in Offline Mode, or when you close it.
- The built-in feature overview, which the Chat uses to answer questions about WhisperShortcut, now explains the MCP connection: meetings in Claude first, then tuning your dictation from your usage, then setup.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.89...v8.90
